title: Nullivance Logic: formal development and reproducible manuscripts
description:
Lean 4 formalization and reproducibility artifact for nullivance logic (NPL). The release includes the propositional two-channel semantics, exact threshold projection to FOUR, a four-signed tableau with verified soundness and completeness, terminating operational proof search with countermodels and progressing-schedule independence, and a finite-domain quantified layer with a verified complete macro-free extensional core tableau. It also retains checked counterexamples refuting two older head-sensitive replay-certificate conjectures and verifies a separate complete membership-selecting repair.

Release 0.7.0 is pinned to Lean 4.32.1 and mathlib v4.32.1 at commit 520045ab14e26149ee970e2e617ca04b09bde5d6. See ARTIFACT.md and run pwsh ./scripts/Verify-Release.ps1.
notes: The public DOI and repository URL are added only after an actual archival deposit. The source package is generated from the annotated release tag with scripts/New-ReleasePackage.ps1 and accompanied by a SHA-256 checksum.
